svg.title: Fuse Box Maps
svg.text: Fuse Box Maps — 2008 Honda Fit (base trim, GD3)
Appendix D / Chapter 32. Schematic numbered-grid layout, not a photo of the real fuse box lid. Amperages and circuit names are copied from the owner's manual's fuse tables.
Location: behind the driver's coin tray on the dashboard. Turn the coin-tray dial counterclockwise and pull the tray out to reach it. (Fact F-WP21-002)
Gray cells (#2, #5, #19, #20, #24, #30) are empty slots — “Not Used” in the owner's manual (Fact
F-WP21-011). Position #18 carries two possible fuse/circuit pairs depending on equipment (TPMS or
Canada-market DRL); see Fact F-WP21-014. Positions #27 (ACC Socket) and #26 (Radio) are the two
fuses most owners look for first.
Under-hood box location: engine compartment, driver's side; push the lid tabs to open (Fact
F-WP21-003). Secondary box location: on the battery's positive terminal, in the engine compartment
(Fact F-WP21-004). The vehicle has exactly 3 fuse boxes total (Fact F-WP21-001) — there is no
separate relay map in the owner's manual (Fact F-WP21-015, UNVERIFIED).
Caption: The three fuse boxes of a 2008 Honda Fit base trim, with every numbered position's amperage and protected circuit, for Chapter 32 (Fuses) and Appendix D.

Source facts: F-WP21-001 through F-WP21-014, and the Interior / Under-hood / Secondary fuse tables in facts/WP-21.md. Amperages shown are stated by the 2008 Fit Owner's Manual (Tier 1) and cross-checked position-by-position against a second source; see facts/WP-21.md for full citations.
